caption: A directed graph: every edge has an arrow and goes one way only

steps.caption: From 0 you can go to 1, the way the arrow points

steps.ask: Can you go from 1 straight back to 0?
steps.caption: No: the only arrow out of 1 goes to 2
Each edge is written from where it starts to where it ends: 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-0
